In 2017, the highest number of orders was placed in December, with 5,673 orders, followed closely by November with 7,544 orders. Orders were significantly lower in January, with only 800 orders, and decreased further in February to 1,780 orders. Orders continued to decrease through March, April, and May, reaching their lowest point in May with 3,700 orders.
